text: Assumption: The ara::core::StringView returned by toString() is bound to the lifetime of the source buffer — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The ara::core::StringView returned by toString() is bound to the lifetime of the source buffer — is this correct?
norm: the ara core stringview returned by tostring is bound to the lifetime of the source buffer
assumption: The ara::core::StringView returned by toString() is bound to the lifetime of the source buffer.
rationale: StringView does not manage its own memory and the specification is silent on memory binding.

original.text: Annahme: Die von toString() gelieferte ara::core::StringView dürfte an die Lebensdauer des Quellpuffers gebunden sein — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Die von toString() gelieferte ara::core::StringView dürfte an die Lebensdauer des Quellpuffers gebunden sein
original.rationale: StringView verwaltet keinen eigenen Speicher und die Spezifikation schweigt zur Speicherbindung.
